description: We are seeking a dedicated Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This vital leadership role offers a competitive annual salary range of $60,000 - $75,000, reflecting your experience and qualifications. We are particularly interested in candidates who are Registered Nurses (RNs) to help us maintain our high standards of patient care and operational excellence.The ADON will play a crucial role in supporting the Director of Nursing, overseeing daily nursing operations, and ensuring the delivery of compassionate and effective care to our residents. This position is an excellent opportunity for a seasoned nursing professional looking to advance their leadership career within a supportive and dynamic environment. If you are passionate about making a difference in the lives of others and possess strong clinical and leadership skills, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Minimum of 2-3 years of nursing experience, preferably in a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting
Prior leadership or supervisory experience in a healthcare environment
Strong understanding of nursing best practices and regulatory compliance
Excellent communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $60,000 - $75,000, based on experience and qualifications.
